([[Elkton, Virginia]]) | college = * [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]] (2022–2023) * [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]] (2023–2024) * [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt]] (2024–2026) | draft_year = 2026 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 47 | draft_team = [[Phoenix Suns]] | career_start = 2026 | years1 = {{nbay|2026|start}}–present | team1 = [[New York Knicks]] | highlights = }} '''Tyler Christopher Nickel''' (born September 5, 2003) is an American [[basketball]] player for the [[New York Knicks]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]], [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech Hokies]] and [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt Commodores]]. ==Early life and high school== Nickel attended [[East Rockingham High School]] in [[Elkton, Virginia]]. As a [[Junior (education year)|junior]], he averaged 33.7 points, 10.1 rebounds, 3.9 assists and 1.6 steals per game.{{cite web |last=Fowler |first=Chapel |title=Will UNC basketball land 4-star 2022 forward Tyler Nickel this week? Experts say yes |url=https://www.fayobserver.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2021/09/14/unc-tar-heels-basketball-hubert-davis-tyler-nickel-recruiting-4-star-east-rockingham-high-school/8338576002/ |website=The Fayetteville Observer |date=14 September 2021 |access-date=17 June 2026}} Coming out of high school, Nickel was rated as a four-star recruit by [[247Sports]], receiving offers from schools such as [[Butler Bulldogs men's basketball|Butler]], [[LSU Tigers men's basketball|LSU]], [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]] and [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]].{{cite web |last=Fowler |first=Chapel |title=UNC basketball enters an either-or situation with two 2022 recruits. How will the Tar Heels handle it? |url=https://www.fayobserver.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2021/09/02/unc-basketball-recruiting-2022-cam-whitmore-tyler-nickel/5647918001/ |website=The Fayetteville Observer |date=2 September 2021 |access-date=17 June 2026}} He committed to play [[college basketball]] at North Carolina.{{cite web |last=Eck |first=TJ |title=Nickel officially signs with UNC |url=https://www.whsv.com/2021/11/10/nickel-officially-signs-with-unc/ |website=WHSV.com |date=10 November 2021 |access-date=17 June 2026}} ==College career== === North Carolina === As a [[freshman]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]], Nickel played in 25 games, averaging 2.1 points and 0.6 rebounds per game. After the season, he entered the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web |last=Pearson |first=Zack |title=Former UNC forward drawing interest in transfer portal |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/former-unc-forward-drawing-interest-022513103.html |website=Yahoo Sports |access-date=2026-06-17|date=2023-03-21}} === Virginia Tech === Nickel transferred to play for the [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech Hokies]].{{cite web |last=Tipton |first=Joe |title=North Carolina transfer Tyler Nickel commits to Virginia Tech |url=https://www.on3.com/college/virginia-tech-hokies/news/north-carolina-transfer-tyler-nickel-commits-to-virginia-tech/ |website=On3.com |access-date=17 June 2026|url-status=dead}} On January 10, 2024, he dropped 24 points and five three-pointers in a victory versus [[2023–24 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]].{{cite web |last=Haren |first=Jarvis |title=East Rockingham grad Tyler Nickel shines in Virginia Tech win over No. 21 Clemson |url=https://www.whsv.com/2024/01/11/east-rockingham-grad-tyler-nickel-shines-virginia-tech-win-over-no-21-clemson/ |website=WHSV.com |date=11 January 2024 |access-date=17 June 2026}} Nickel finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] averaging 8.8 points, 2.2 rebounds and 1.3 assists in 33 games played with seven starts. After the season, he once again entered the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web |last=Haren |first=Jarvis |title=REPORT: East Rock grad Nickel to enter transfer portal |url=https://www.whsv.com/2024/03/29/report-east-rock-grad-nickel-enter-transfer-portal/ |website=WHSV.com |date=29 March 2024 |access-date=17 June 2026}}{{cite web |last=Gershon |first=Aaron |title=Kentucky in contact with Virginia Tech transfer Tyler Nickel |url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/article/tyler-nickel-kentucky-wildcats-transfer-portal-229737372/ |website=247Sports |access-date=2026-06-17|date=2024-04-02}} === Vanderbilt === Nickel transferred to play for the [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt Commodores]].{{cite web |last=Gerson |first=Aria |title=How Tyler Nickel, Jalen Washington basketball journey ended at Vanderbilt basketball |access-date=17 June 2026}} On February 14, 2026, he scored a game-high 25 points in a victory over [[2025–26 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]].{{cite web |last=Skrbina |first=Paul
